region._comment: Two 128 KB sectors at the end of bank 2. CM4 code lives at 0x08100000 and currently uses <200 KB so there is plenty of room before 0x081C0000. Codegen emits a linker fragment that reserves both sectors; CM4's stm32h745xx_flash_CM4.ld INCLUDEs it.

calibration._comment: Inertial bias estimates persisted by the state-estimation task after the boot cal window completes.

flight_stats._comment: Lifetime counters and the last fault snapshot. Bumped by mission manager + crash dump.

fields.name: boot_count
fields.description: Cumulative boots since flash was first programmed.

fields.name: flight_count
fields.description: Cumulative flights (RISE transitions) since flash was first programmed.

fields.name: last_boot_us
fields.description: Timestamp of the current boot, in microseconds since power-on.

fields.name: last_fault_pc
fields.description: PC at last HardFault/MemManage/BusFault/UsageFault, or 0 if no fault has occurred since first program.

vehicle_config._comment: Vehicle-specific physical parameters. Updated rarely (mass change after refuel, etc.).

fields.name: gimbal_arm_m
fields.description: Distance from CoM to thrust application point [m].
